Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1367
Claimant:
Kevin Pearson
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
January 25, 2025
Claim received by phone from the claimant, who reports a low-speed collision in a parking lot and a wrist fracture
from the impact. The claimant is not represented by an attorney and has been asked to send photos and the police
report reference.
March 22, 2025
Reviewed the policy and confirmed the driver is listed as a named insured on the policy in force at the time. Vehicle
damage photos received; the rear bumper and tail light damage appears consistent with the described impact.
May 29, 2025
Spoke with the claimant again and the account of the incident matched the first call in every detail. The police report
and two parties on scene confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time. No independent witnesses have come
forward.
June 5, 2025
Medical records show a wrist fracture with a treatment course that followed a typical pattern, with physical therapy
tapering as the claimant improved. The injury apperas consistent with the kind and force of this type of collision.
Records also note a small strain to the same area several years ago that healed fully.
July 22, 2025
A neighbor contacted the office and believes the vehicle already had damage a few weeks before the claimed date of
loss. No earlier damage to the vehicle is recorded in our files, and the neighbor's statement has not yet been verified.
August 4, 2025
Photos confirm several details of the scene and damage, though they do not resolve the timing question raised by the
neighbor. Next steps are to request the vehicle's prior repair history and a follow-up statement from the neighbor
before making a coverage decision.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
